titleEn: How Much Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in Port Moody, BC? Real 2026 Project Budgets
titleZh: 高贵林港厨房装修费用2026：真实装修预算公开
contentEn:
A kitchen renovation in Port Moody, BC costs between $30,000 and $180,000 in 2026, depending on the scope of work. A minor cosmetic refresh averages $30,000–$55,000, a standard mid-range renovation runs $55,000–$100,000, and a full custom kitchen overhaul lands at $100,000–$180,000 or higher. These figures reflect actual project costs from Reno Stars clients across the Tri-Cities area, including Port Moody.

Cost by Renovation Scope

Renovation TypeCost RangeWhat Is Included
Minor refresh$30,000 – $55,000Cabinet refinishing, new countertop, faucet, backsplash, paint
Standard mid-range$55,000 – $100,000New flat-panel cabinets, quartz countertop, appliance upgrades, flooring
Full custom overhaul$100,000 – $180,000+Custom cabinetry, natural stone countertop, structural changes, full rewiring

What Drives the Price Up in Port Moody

Port Moody homes — from compact condos in Newport Village to single-family houses in Heritage Mountain — vary widely in kitchen layout. Older condos often have dated electrical panels that require upgrading before major appliance installations. Multi-level townhouses may need load calculations for new induction cooktops. Each of these conditions adds to the project cost but is explicitly scoped and quoted before work begins.

Material choices account for the largest variable. Quartz countertops range from $55 to $150 per square foot installed. Custom hardwood cabinets start around $12,000 for a medium kitchen and can exceed $40,000 for large or highly custom designs. Imported tile and premium fixtures round out the higher end of the budget.

Planning a kitchen renovation in Port Moody, Coquitlam, or the Tri-Cities area? Get a free quote from Reno Stars.

Real Port Moody and Tri-Cities Project Examples

Reno Stars has completed kitchen renovations across the Tri-Cities. Recent projects include a modern kitchen renovation in Coquitlam featuring custom shaker cabinets and a waterfall quartz island, a minimalist kitchen in Richmond with wood grain cabinets and quartz countertops, and a white shaker kitchen in Langley. These projects demonstrate the range of styles and budgets available to Port Moody homeowners.

Timeline: How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take?

  • Minor refresh: 3–5 weeks
  • Standard renovation: 6–10 weeks
  • Full custom overhaul: 10–16 weeks

Permits are not typically required for kitchen renovations in Port Moody unless structural changes are involved — such as removing a load-bearing wall or relocating gas lines. Reno Stars handles permit assessment as part of the initial quoting process.

How to Budget for Your Port Moody Kitchen Renovation

Start with a realistic total budget and work backward. Industry guidance recommends allocating no more than 15–20% of your home's current value to a kitchen renovation. For a Port Moody home assessed at $900,000–$1.3 million, that suggests a budget ceiling of roughly $135,000–$260,000 — well within the full custom range.

Always include a 10–15% contingency fund for unforeseen issues, particularly in older condos and heritage homes where concealed water damage or outdated wiring is common.

How much does a small kitchen renovation cost in Port Moody?

A minor kitchen refresh in Port Moody — including cabinet refinishing, new countertop, faucet, backsplash, and paint — typically costs $30,000–$55,000. Timeline is 3–5 weeks.

What is the average cost of a kitchen renovation in Port Moody, BC?

The average mid-range kitchen renovation in Port Moody costs $55,000–$100,000 in 2026. This covers new flat-panel cabinets, quartz countertop, appliance upgrades, and new flooring in a standard-sized kitchen.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in Port Moody?

Most kitchen renovations in Port Moody do not require a permit. Permits are only needed when the work involves structural changes, gas line relocation, or significant electrical panel upgrades. Reno Stars assesses permit requirements during the quoting stage.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in Port Moody?

A standard kitchen renovation in Port Moody takes 6–10 weeks from demolition to final inspection. A full custom overhaul can take 10–16 weeks. Minor cosmetic refreshes are completed in 3–5 weeks.

Yes. Reno Stars has completed kitchen renovations throughout the Tri-Cities area, including Port Moody, Coquitlam, and Port Coquitlam. Quotes are free and include a detailed scope of work, material options, and timeline.
contentZh:
高贵林港（Port Moody）厨房装修费用在2026年介于$30,000至$180,000加元之间，具体取决于装修范围。轻度翻新工程平均为$30,000至$55,000，标准中档装修为$55,000至$100,000，全面定制厨房改造则高达$100,000至$180,000或以上。这些数据基于Reno Stars在温哥华三联市（Tri-Cities）地区包括高贵林港的实际客户项目。

按装修范围的费用明细

装修类型费用范围包含项目
轻度翻新$30,000 – $55,000橱柜翻新、新台面、水龙头、挡水板、墙面油漆
标准中档$55,000 – $100,000新平板门橱柜、石英石台面、设备升级、地板更换
全屋定制$100,000 – $180,000+定制橱柜、天然石材台面、结构改造、全屋线路更新

高贵林港装修费用上涨的主要原因

高贵林港的房屋类型多样，从纽波特村（Newport Village）的紧凑型公寓到 Heritage Mountain 的独立屋，厨房布局差异显著。老旧公寓通常需要升级配电箱才能安装大功率电器。联排别墅可能需要对新增电磁炉进行负载计算。这些都是报价时需要考虑的因素。

材料选择是最大的变量。石英石台面每平方尺安装费用从$55到$150不等。定制实木橱柜起价约$12,000，中型厨房可能超过$40,000，尺寸大或定制程度高则更贵。进口瓷砖和高端五金配件进一步推高预算。

高贵林港及三联市真实工程案例

Reno Stars已在三联市完成多个厨房装修工程。近期项目包括高贵林港一套现代风格厨房，特色是定制橱柜和石英石瀑布式中岛台；列治文的一套极简风格厨房，采用木纹橱柜和石英石台面；以及兰里的白色橱柜厨房。这些项目展示了高贵林港业主可选择的风格和预算范围。

工期：厨房装修需要多长时间？

  • 轻度翻新：3至5周
  • 标准装修：6至10周
  • 全屋定制：10至16周

高贵林港的厨房装修通常不需要许可证，除非涉及结构改造、煤气管道移位或主要电气升级。Reno Stars会在报价阶段评估许可证要求。

如何为高贵林港厨房装修制定预算

从实际总预算出发反向规划。行业指引建议厨房装修费用不超过房屋当前估值的15%至20%。对于估值在$900,000至$130万的高贵林港房屋，预算上限约为$135,000至$260,000，完全在全面定制装修的范围内。

始终预留10%至15%的应急资金，用于处理老旧公寓和 Heritage 住宅中常见的隐蔽水损或线路老化等意外问题。

高贵林港小厨房装修费用是多少？

高贵林港轻度厨房翻新（包括橱柜翻新、新台面、水龙头、挡水板和墙面油漆）通常费用为$30,000至$55,000，工期为3至5周。

高贵林港厨房装修平均费用是多少？

2026年高贵林港标准中档厨房装修平均费用为$55,000至$100,000，包含新平板门橱柜、石英石台面、设备升级和标准尺寸厨房地板更换。

高贵林港厨房装修需要许可证吗？

高贵林港大多数厨房装修不需要许可证。只有在涉及结构改造、煤气管道移位或主要电气升级时才需要许可证。Reno Stars会在报价阶段评估许可证要求。

高贵林港厨房装修需要多长时间？

高贵林港标准厨房装修从拆除到最终验收需6至10周。全面定制装修需10至16周。轻度翻新可在3至5周内完成。

Reno Stars是否承接高贵林港的厨房装修？

是的。Reno Stars已在三联市地区（包括高贵林港、高贵林和满地宝）完成多个厨房装修工程。报价免费，包含详细工程范围、材料选择和工期安排。
